conclusion: Game of the Week is entered from single player only when the user's sign-in state is 2. It sets the setup mode word to 2 and derives the week locally: a week index W from the console clock as a 2006-based day count divided by 7, a seed selected from MapList or a supplied nonzero word, and a player civilization derived from the week, map count and seed. overrideBoundary supplies the exact input widths, wrapping arithmetic, count-stability guards and unresolved retention into later generation. The game starts only when session setup 0x82D8F398 returns 1, which requires creating the session object through the shared XSession wrapper (host create flags 0x707 on the traced branch). Results are written through message 0x000B0025 to views selected by difficulty, and controller 42 with screen 46 is the leaderboard route. The bounded leaderboard packet establishes four request kinds, full-width guest XUID pivots, overlapped single-enumeration consumption, valid-empty-view semantics, 48/24-byte result strides, signed-INT64 property writes with a conditional victory child, an existing reset wrapper, and native Weekly/Max/Last metadata. All 25 GotW custom-column joins, score/rating intent, victory-child concepts, signed year and encoded Leader fields, selector mechanics and independent child submission guards are recorded in leaderboardColumnMap. Explicit service sort/ties, initial setup/page writers, final movie conversion, real-win child delivery, UI factory/loader closure, store week/companion semantics and the earlier wait stack remain open. manualMapSeedBoundary records the owner-reported civilization/map split, concrete later automatic rewrite and separate construction/visual-key inputs, with an ordered runtime discriminator and conditional title intervention contract.

R4.result: Result parser consumes only the first returned view, requires its ID to match request +0x2C, skips rank-zero rows, copies full XUIDs and converts selected column types. Enumerate helper receives the create size and handle, allocates and zeros exactly that size, then calls XamEnumerate with handle, flags 0, buffer, size, items-returned pointer NULL, and overlapped object +0x58. Immediate 0 parses now; 997 means pending. No second enumeration of the same handle occurs in the selected submit/completion path. The guest expects no items-returned value on this path because it passes NULL.

R5.result: A matching first view with zero rows returns parser success at 0x82E64504. Zero views, wrong view ID, null request context +0x24, or null buffer +0x54 returns false at 0x82E64508. Nonzero create status avoids enumerate and produces handler default 3. Immediate enumerate error other than 997 returns false from the helper. Friends requires probe status 122 and nonzero size; actual submit accepts 0 or 997. Poll 0x82E64918 only runs pending completion when object +0x74 is 997; it waits while overlap first word +0x58 remains 997. When the word changes, it clears +0x74 and invokes the parser callback without checking the completed error code locally.
